intent.design_goal: Dual-stream join with accumulation, streaming interface

control_flow.name: in0_buffer_load
control_flow.effects: skid_buf0_data = top.in0_data; skid_buf0_valid = 1

control_flow.name: in1_buffer_load
control_flow.effects: skid_buf1_data = top.in1_data; skid_buf1_valid = 1

control_flow.name: join_handshake

intent.design_goal: Implement a reliable, backpressure-tolerant stream fork that duplicates an 8-bit valid-ready input to two independent output streams, using a skid buffer for input elasticity and pipeline stages for output registration.
assumptions: All components share the same clock domain
External ready signals are well-behaved (no combinational loops)
Data width is fixed at 8 bits

components.name: skid_buffer
components.intent: Provides one-entry skid buffer to decouple input backpressure from the fork, allowing full throughput when possible and storing one data word when downstream stalls.

components.name: stream_fork
components.intent: Duplicates the incoming valid-ready stream to two independent output streams. The input is acknowledged only when both outputs are ready.

components.name: stream_stage
components.intent: Registers the valid and data signals, adding one cycle of latency. Used to provide clean output timing and isolate output backpressure.

one transfer per cycle when ready

scenarios.name: basic_transfer
scenarios.description: Send a single data word, check both outputs match after expected latency.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Both outputs receive the same data with correct valid timing.

scenarios.name: backpressure_output0
scenarios.description: Deassert out0_ready while sending data, verify that output0 stalls and skid buffer can absorb, then release and check data consistency.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No data loss, correct duplication, and no glitches.

scenarios.name: full_throughput
scenarios.description: Send a stream of data at maximum rate, verify both outputs sustain one transfer per cycle.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Throughput maintained and data duplicated correctly.

verification.pass_condition: Testbench prints TEST_PASS and no TEST_FAIL

components.name: skid_buffer
components.intent: Provides a buffered valid-ready interface with capacity for one outstanding transfer. Behaves as a shallow FIFO with bypass capability, adding no latency when downstream is ready and buffering a single beat when stalled.

components.name: stream_fork
components.intent: Duplicates an input valid-ready stream to two output valid-ready streams. Handles back-pressure independently: input ready is the logical AND of out0_ready and out1_ready.

components.name: stream_stage
components.intent: Registers a valid-ready data transfer, providing one cycle of latency. Accepts input when it can resample; outputs valid data on the next cycle.

scenarios.name: basic_forwarding
scenarios.description: Send a single valid input with both outputs ready. Expect both outputs to receive the same data after two cycles (skid buffer + stage pipeline).
scenarios.pass_condition: out0_data == in_data && out1_data == in_data at the proper cycle.

scenarios.name: backpressure_out0
scenarios.description: Send data while out0_ready=0 and out1_ready=1. out1 should receive the data; out0 should buffer and then output when out0_ready asserts.
scenarios.pass_condition: out1 replicates data, out0 replicates later without loss.

scenarios.name: backpressure_out1
scenarios.description: Same as above but out1_ready=0 first.
scenarios.pass_condition: Both outputs eventually duplicate data.

scenarios.name: full_stall_then_drain
scenarios.description: Send multiple beats while both outputs are stalled. After releasing, all data should appear in order on both outputs.
scenarios.pass_condition: Sequence matches input on both out0 and out1.

verification.pass_condition: testbench prints TEST_PASS and no TEST_FAIL

scenarios.expected: No sum update while stalled; accumulation resumes after stall.

intent.design_goal: Implement an 8-bit valid-ready stream fork with skid buffer input stage and two registered output stages, suitable for generic FPGA synthesis.

Skid buffer provides one pipeline stage to improve timing on input

components.name: skid_buffer
components.intent: One-deep skid buffer that registers incoming data to improve timing, with full valid/ready backpressure.

components.name: stream_fork
components.intent: Duplicates a valid/ready input stream to two identical output streams, asserting out_valid only when both output ready signals are high.

components.name: stream_stage
components.intent: Single pipeline stage that registers the input stream, providing an output register for valid and data.

timing.throughput: one transfer per cycle when ready
one transfer per cycle when ready

scenarios.name: basic_transfer
scenarios.description: Send one sample with all ready signals high, check that both outputs receive the sample after 2 cycles.
scenarios.stimuli: Drive in_valid high with in_data=0x55 for 1 cycle, hold out0_ready and out1_ready high.
scenarios.checks: After latency, out0_data==0x55 and out1_data==0x55, out0_valid and out1_valid high.

scenarios.name: backpressure_out0
scenarios.description: Deassert out0_ready while out1_ready high; verify that both outputs stall (fork requires both ready).
scenarios.stimuli: Send sample, then hold out0_ready low.
scenarios.checks: No new valid on either output while out0_ready low.

scenarios.name: backpressure_out1
scenarios.description: Deassert out1_ready while out0_ready high; verify stall.
scenarios.stimuli: Send sample, then hold out1_ready low.
scenarios.checks: No new valid on either output while out1_ready low.

scenarios.name: consecutive_transfers
scenarios.description: Transfer multiple samples back-to-back.
scenarios.stimuli: Drive in_valid continuously with changing data, keep both out_readys high.
scenarios.checks: Each data appears on both outputs two cycles later, no dropped samples.

verification.pass_condition: Testbench prints TEST_PASS and no TEST_FAIL

intent.design_goal: Implement an 8-bit dual-stream join datapath with two skid buffers, a stream join unit, an accumulator, and an output pipeline stage. The design must correctly handle valid-ready handshakes, buffer and synchronize the two input streams, join them into a single stream, accumulate results, and present the final output with a register stage.
assumptions: Joined data width is 16 bits (concatenation of two 8-bit inputs)
Accumulator sum width is 9 bits (DATA_WIDTH+1) to avoid overflow, configurable via ACCUM_WIDTH
All valid-ready interfaces follow standard handshake: transfer occurs when both valid and ready are high at the same cycle
Skid buffers can store at most one data beat
Stream join is combinational: asserts out_valid only when both inputs are valid and output ready is high, and produces joined data immediately
Accumulator adds the received joined sample to its internal sum register on each valid transfer
Stream stage is a single pipeline register with valid/ready handshake
Testbench will drive random stimulus with backpressure and verify functional correctness

components.name: stream_stage
components.intent: Inserts a single register stage with skid capability, preserving the valid-ready protocol and adding one cycle of latency
